offering_description.value: Textron designs and builds business and general aviation aircraft and commercial and military rotorcraft for private owners, fleet operators and governments. It also manufactures automotive components, specialty vehicles and defense systems. It provides aircraft maintenance, training and financing.

primary_products.value: business jets and other fixed-wing aircraft; helicopters and tiltrotor aircraft; automotive fuel systems; golf cars and utility vehicles; uncrewed and ground defense systems

primary_services.value: aircraft maintenance and overhaul; aircraft modifications; pilot and technician training; defense systems integration and sustainment; aircraft financing

customer_segment.value: B2B: corporate flight departments, charter and helicopter operators, automakers, golf courses and defense contractors; B2G: military procurement agencies, law enforcement agencies and other public aircraft operators; B2C: private aircraft owners and personal golf car buyers

end_markets.value: business and general aviation; defense; automotive manufacturing; golf and commercial grounds maintenance; public safety and emergency services

revenue_model.value: product sales: aircraft, replacement parts, automotive components and specialty vehicles; project or contract: military aircraft and defense systems development, production and sustainment; service fees: aircraft maintenance, modifications and training; interest or premiums: financing for buyers of Textron aircraft
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds aircraft, specialty vehicles and defense systems from purchased materials and components for private, commercial and government customers; component supplier: supplies molded fuel systems and related components to automakers; service provider: maintains and upgrades aircraft for operators and supports defense equipment for government customers; financial intermediary: provides purchase financing to aircraft buyers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: fixed-wing aircraft, rotorcraft, automotive components, specialty vehicles, defense systems and aircraft finance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: manufacturer sales teams for aircraft, automotive supply contracts and government programs; distributors / dealers: independent golf car and utility vehicle dealers; own locations: company-operated aircraft service centers; online: manufacturer-operated aircraft parts ordering portal; partners / resellers: authorized aircraft service facilities
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations; online; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: aircraft certification and production approvals from the FAA and foreign aviation authorities, plus U.S. defense export controls

notes: The current scope of Textron’s electric aviation operations is uncertain.
